meta.title: Weekly KPI Dashboard
notes: Weeks after 2026-10-03 were treated as placeholders or plan values (fewer than 2 KPIs reporting) and were removed. 13 week(s), 39 rows.
34 duplicate rows with identical values were removed.
Excluded on purpose (marked "(drop)" in KPI_Map): QA / Lbs Produced - (Complaints per MM).
Department labels in the source were over-filled downward, so KPIs are grouped by KPI_Map (Section and Group), not by the Department column.
Targets are scored (On / Off target) only where KPI_Map has a Score Op and Score Value, or the Target cell itself has an operator such as <2. Other targets are shown but not scored.
Near Miss and Customer Complaints sub-items are blank when zero in the source; they are filled with 0 for weeks the parent reported (Fill Zero = Y).
The second "Line" series (ratio values 0.4 to 1.9) has no label in the source; it is shown as Line Performance (ratio).
